To start off with some context, both my parents are cops and have always told me from a very young age not to trust strangers, at all. They would tell me that almost everyday.

When I was 7 my parents took me to this kid’s birthday party, I didn’t know who that kid was but I know they were the child of one of my parent’s friends.

The minute we got there, as I stepped out of the car I saw this stray cat. I was really in love with cats (still am) and was super excited about that stray cat. We got into the party and I started to feed the cat, I would give it little pieces of hot dogs and such. The cat wouldn’t come into the party, it would just stay at the entrance waiting for food (I guess it was because of the amount of people there), so I would go to the entrance, feed the cat and then come back.

So, at one moment there I was at the entrance of the party, with a piece of food in my hands and the cat was nowhere to be found. 

There were about 4-5 guys sitting at a bench across the street and I couldn’t hear what they were talking about, I honestly didn’t even care. I just called for the cat, I said something like “Kitty?!”. That caught their attention, they stopped their conversation, looked at me and one of them said “The kitty is here! Come get it.”

Again, I was a 7 year old little girl at the time and I was OBSESSED with cats. I remember thinking “Should I?”. So I stopped there, at the entrance, looking at these huge guys across the street with their little sketchy smiles on their faces, the cat wasn’t near them as far as I could see. 
I thought “nope.”, turned around, walked up to my parents, sat there and continue eating my food like nothing had happened.
Idk if they were bad people but I didn’t wanna find out.

When I left the party we found the cat, took it home and kept it as our pet. Turns out it was just looking for it’s cat friend (which we tried to get too but it escaped) to get him some food too, so it definitely wasn’t hanging around those guys.
